description.content:
The controller is responsible for managing company templates. 
Templates for text messages and emails. 
The controller allows creating new templates which can include information about dataObjects and current user.
All templates that users can use to send SMS/MMS/Email to customers. Users can send them manually or automatically using the autoplay feature.
